thesis: The podcast argues that the healthcare industry faces a critical supply-demand mismatch driven by structural constraints on training, licensure, and an aging workforce, alongside high burnout rates that caused over 300,000 clinicians to leave the workforce in 2021. It proposes 'super staffing' as a solution to address these challenges by leveraging AI to improve productivity and manage the increasing complexity of patient care.
